property_summary: For any call to newGrantProposal(recipient, amount) the reference contract increases proposalCount by exactly 1 (new value = old value + 1); the mutant that double-increments will make proposalCount increase by 2 for some inputs, violating this invariant.
change_summary: Double-increment proposalCount (add an extra increment), so proposalCount increases by 2 per call, changing its value after the call.
